31	    def to_dict(self) -> dict:
32	        return dataclasses.asdict(self)
33	
34	    @classmethod
35	    def from_dict(cls, d: dict) -> "RoleAssignmentRecord":
36	        return cls(
37	            deliverable_pattern=str(d.get("deliverable_pattern", "")),
38	            owner_role=str(d.get("owner_role", "")),
39	            project_id=str(d.get("project_id", "")),
40	            pass_count=max(0, int(d.get("pass_count", 1))),
41	            fail_count=max(0, int(d.get("fail_count", 0))),
42	        )
43	
44	    @property
45	    def score(self) -> float:
46	        total = self.pass_count + self.fail_count
47	        if total == 0:
48	            return 0.0
49	        return self.pass_count / total
